Cigna Appeals Department

Re: Appeal of Adverse Benefit Determination  
Member: Emerson Alvarez  
Member ID: W977514824  
Plan: Cigna Commercial/ACA, Missouri  
Reference number: POC-4E415360FE-32022  
Requested service: Total hip replacement  
CPT code: 27130  
Date of denial notice: August 9, 2026  

Dear Cigna Appeals Reviewer:

I am appealing Cigna’s denial of prior authorization for my total hip replacement, CPT 27130. The denial states that the submitted documentation was incomplete and did not allow a determination of medical necessity. The clinical records summarized below provide the information needed to evaluate the medical necessity of this procedure.

I have experienced 24 months of progressive hip pain that has not been relieved by rest. The condition substantially limits my daily functioning. I require a cane for ambulation, can walk only approximately one block, and cannot put on my shoes without assistance. Examination documented positive provocative testing on the affected side, with range of motion limited by pain.

The medical records also document significant structural hip disease. A weight-bearing AP pelvis radiograph obtained on June 2, 2026, showed superolateral joint-space narrowing to 1 mm, subchondral sclerosis, and osteophyte formation. These findings are consistent with advanced degenerative changes involving the hip joint and correlate with my persistent pain, restricted motion, and functional impairment.

I have completed extensive conservative treatment without adequate or durable improvement:

- Sixteen weeks of supervised physical therapy focused on hip abductor strengthening and gait, from March 3, 2026, through June 23, 2026, for a total of 20 visits. The physical therapy discharge note documents completion of this treatment.
- Four months of NSAID therapy, with inadequate relief.
- A corticosteroid injection on May 15, 2026, which provided only three weeks of partial relief.

The requested surgery is being recommended by Lindqvist, MD, orthopedic surgery, after prolonged symptoms, objective radiographic abnormalities, functional deterioration, and failure of appropriate nonsurgical care. The records therefore establish the diagnosis, severity, duration, functional impact, objective findings, and unsuccessful conservative treatment necessary for a medical-necessity review.

The submitted records also identify no apparent clinical barrier to proceeding with surgery: there is no active infection, no untreated substance use, BMI is 29, and I am a nonsmoker.

The plan’s specific clinical-review criteria have not been quoted in this appeal because the complete policy text and the exact criteria applied to reference number POC-4E415360FE-32022 were not provided with the denial notice. Please identify the precise criteria and policy version used in reviewing this request and consider the enclosed records under those criteria.

I respectfully request that Cigna overturn the denial and authorize the medically necessary total hip replacement, CPT 27130. If Cigna believes any additional information is required, please identify the specific missing document or clinical fact and provide an opportunity to submit it. I also request a complete copy of the clinical-review rationale and the applicable criteria used in this determination.

Please send the appeal decision and any request for additional information to:

Emerson Alvarez  
[Mailing address]  
[Telephone number]  
[Email address]

Sincerely,

Emerson Alvarez  
Member ID: W977514824

Enclosures:

- Denial notice dated August 9, 2026
- Weight-bearing AP pelvis radiograph report dated June 2, 2026
- Orthopedic surgery evaluation and recommendation from Lindqvist, MD
- Physical therapy records and discharge note documenting 20 visits from March 3, 2026, through June 23, 2026
- Medication history documenting four months of NSAID treatment
- Corticosteroid injection record dated May 15, 2026
- Clinical examination and functional limitation records
